summary:
Main
Today, the DCE iron ore futures moved steadily today. The most-traded DCE I2609 contract closed at 716.5 yuan/mt, up 0.35% from the previous session.Spot prices at Qingdao Port averaged a decline of about 0-2 yuan/mt from the previous trading day. Trader activity was moderate, steel mills purchased as needed, and overall spot transactions were modest.
